title: Staffing pressure can enter compensation decisions
caption: I classify this claim as mechanism supported only. Reviewed sources explicitly use recruitment, retention, comparator, vacancy, and staffing pressure to justify schedule changes or targeted premiums in some public-safety settings. The broader evidence can add context or direction, but it cannot erase the strict evidence boundary. The main limit is unsearched, storage-held, conflict, linkage, compatibility, and independent-human-review limits remain. This card states what I can use in the report and what I must not turn into a national or causal conclusion.
